_: Latest known version of each bench-extra reference library (pyproject.toml's [bench] extra is unpinned, so there is no lockfile to read statically). scripts/check_standings.py compares a quality axis's recorded refs against this ledger, major-only, when the installed package cannot be detected in the checking environment. update_standings.py refreshes it from the installed environment whenever a quality axis is superseded; bump it by hand the moment a reference library ships a new major even without a full refresh, so the hash-unchanged skip cannot hide behind a stale ledger.
